latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor Clothes — Swap Outfits in Videos (v1.0.0)

- Initial release: Swap clothing in videos using AI, no manual sliders required.
- Supports video uploads (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and outputs 1080p MP4 ready to post.
- Simple workflow: upload a video, describe the new outfit, and download the edited result in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic session setup and authentication, with 100 free credits for new users.
- Built-in commands for exporting, checking credits, and viewing session status.
- Designed for creators, marketers, and anyone wanting fast AI clothing edits without reshooting footage.
